description: Waterfront Apartments with Flexible Payment Plan in Al Mamzar Sharjah Al Mamzar, Sharjah, is a prime waterfront community known for its serene coastal ambiance, stunning skyline views, and proximity to the Dubai border. The thoughtfully planned layouts maximize space and natural light, ensuring a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. Residents can experience a luxurious lifestyle with premium finishes, stylish flooring, and expansive windows that offer breathtaking views of the city and sea. title: 38JH+6C, Dubai
description: Azizi Milan by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential destination in City of Arabia, Dubailand, inspired by the timeless elegance of Italian architecture and design. Drawing inspiration from Milan's renowned Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the development blends distinctive architectural character with modern urban living. Its residential collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximise functionality, natural light, and everyday comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary layouts create bright, inviting interiors suited to both homeowners and property investors. Amenities and lifestyle Designed to bring resort-inspired living into an urban setting, Azizi Milan offers an extensive selection of more than 30 amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and dedicated children's play areas, alongside convenient retail outlets and dining options within the community. One of the development's standout features is its expansive crystal-clear lagoon, creating a striking waterfront atmosphere and adding a leisure-focused dimension to everyday living. Combined with recreational facilities and community spaces, these amenities offer opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and social connection. Finishes and interiors The residences feature modern interiors, quality materials, and practical layouts that balance contemporary style with functionality. Large windows allow natural light to fill the living spaces, while the clean, modern aesthetic provides a versatile foundation for personalisation. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens designed to provide everyday convenience and functionality. Furnishing Unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located in City of Arabia within Dubailand, Azizi Milan is part of a planned mixed-use destination designed to bring residential living, retail, entertainment, and leisure together. The wider area is envisioned as a vibrant urban community with a diverse range of residential options and lifestyle facilities. City of Arabia is associated with major planned attractions, including Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet theme park concept. As development progresses, the wider district aims to offer a blend of shopping, dining, family entertainment, and recreational spaces within a connected community environment. Dubailand provides access to several established residential neighbourhoods and leisure destinations across Dubai. Road connections link the area with other parts of the city, making it a location to consider for residents seeking a contemporary home away from the busiest central districts. Combining Italian-inspired design, a broad range of amenities, and a lagoon-centred lifestyle, Azizi Milan offers a distinctive residential concept for buyers looking for modern living and potential investment opportunities in Dubailand.

raw_area: 687P+G8F - Al Jadaf - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

Ranging from sophisticated studios to grand penthouses, each home features an open-plan layout adorned with refined finishes. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Some three-bedroom residences lead with their size. This one leads with a private pool in the sky. Set on the 12th floor of FashionTV Acacia, this two-level corner residence combines 425.14 m² of total space with an exceptional 180-degree outlook across the sea, pool and internal landscape. The developer plan places 180.47 m² inside and a remarkable 244.67 m² outdoors - giving the terraces more space than the interior itself. The lower level is organised around a six-by-7.7-metre living and dining room, with a defined kitchen and immediate access to the curved terraces. Three substantial bedrooms are supported by three resident bathrooms, dressing areas, a guest powder room, a maid's room with its own bathroom and a separate laundry. Five outdoor zones wrap around the residence. The upper level is conceived as a private open-air retreat, with the developer plan depicting a private pool set into the elevated terrace. The pool, final landscape treatment and all specifications must be confirmed in the SPA and contractual drawings. This is not simply a larger apartment. It is the rare three-bedroom format designed for buyers who want the scale and outdoor presence of a private home while retaining the security, services and elevated position of a branded island residence. FashionTV Acacia is being delivered by BNW Developments, with architecture by Conin International. The wider amenity programme includes an infinity pool, children's pool and play areas, landscaped gardens, a viewing deck, water features, a gymnasium, barbecue and fire-pit areas, family lounges, a café and signature restaurant spaces. Offered at AED 11,937,998, the residence follows the published 50/50 payment plan: 10% on booking, eight instalments of 5% through month 20, and the final 50% on completion. Expected handover is Q2 2028. Al Marjan Island places the property within Ras Al Khaimah's established coastal and resort corridor. Published project information places Al Marjan Boulevard about six minutes away, Wynn Al Marjan Island about seven minutes away and Al Hamra Mall about eleven minutes away. Drive times are indicative. Contact Bhavesh Koonja, REALTOR and Certified International Property Specialist, at Tropical Riviera International Realty for the latest availability confirmation, exact floor plan, payment schedule, contractual specifications and reservation documents. description: Seafront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniya Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is an emerging residential and leisure destination renowned for its tranquil natural beauty and serene island atmosphere. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches, it provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, featuring exclusive residential communities, luxurious amenities, and diverse recreational options such as golfing, water sports, and eco-tourism activities. Its strategic position, away from the city's bustle yet conveniently accessible, makes it an ideal retreat for residents seeking tranquility combined with modern comfort. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious coastal living experience, prominently featuring pristine natural beaches, serene lagoon beaches, and vibrant landscaped parks. Its exterior design is elegantly set along a mesmerizing shoreline with four distinct towers, each with breathtaking views of the turquoise waters and lush greenery. The community is enriched by world-class amenities including an infinity swimming pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, children's play areas, an outdoor cinema, and a community center. For adventure enthusiasts, thrilling water sports such as snorkeling, scuba diving, and kite surfing are readily available. Additional sophisticated conveniences include an exclusive yacht club, a vibrant retail boulevard with open-air cafés and gourmet dining options, an upscale shopping mall, and luxurious resorts. Connectivity is ensured by a picturesque 1.7 km bridge, providing easy access from the urban landscape to the island's tranquility. The project offers meticulously designed interiors that blend contemporary luxury with practical elegance, available in configurations of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Tower A residences are fully furnished, providing immediate comfort and sophisticated style from day one, while Towers B, C, and D are delivered semi-furnished, allowing residents flexibility to personalize their spaces. Each apartment is thoughtfully planned, featuring spacious layouts complemented by premium finishes and fixtures. All units come equipped with fitted wardrobes, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal, and modern kitchens fitted with high-quality white goods, enhancing convenience and elegance. Expansive windows and private balconies optimize natural lighting and allow residents to enjoy serene views of the surrounding natural landscapes, pristine beaches, and tranquil lagoons. The interiors encapsulate a refined lifestyle, with attention to detail evident in every corner, creating a harmonious environment tailored for ultimate comfort and style. UAQ-00006

description: Luxury Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island is a breathtaking coastal destination in Umm Al Quwain, poised to become one of the UAEs most exclusive lifestyle and investment hubs. Surrounded by pristine beaches and unspoiled natural beauty, the island offers a serene escape while remaining well-connected to the mainland. Planned as a premium residential and leisure community, Siniyah Island will feature luxury beachfront properties, high-end resorts, a championship golf course, world-class amenities, and a marinaall designed to blend modern living with nature. With its strategic location and visionary development, Siniyah Island is set to redefine waterfront living in the Northern Emirates. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project showcases a breathtaking beachfront lifestyle, offering residents an immersive blend of nature, luxury, and recreation. Designed with elegance and coastal harmony in mind, the development features refined architectural elements with towers gracefully oriented toward stunning seascapes. Residents enjoy direct access to both a natural beach and a pristine lagoon, along with world-class amenities including an infinity swimming pool, outdoor cinema, landscaped parks, children's play areas, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. The community is enriched with upscale facilities such as a yacht marina, exclusive golf course, helipad, vibrant retail boulevard, gourmet dining spots, and a community centre. For the adventurous, the island offers thrilling water sports like kite surfing, scuba diving, and paddle boarding, all set against the backdrop of untouched natural beauty and spectacular sunset views. This sanctuary blends tranquil escapes with vibrant activity, creating a unique coastal lifestyle where every detail is tailored for leisure, wellness, and timeless living. The project features elegant interiors crafted for contemporary coastal living, offering spacious 2-bedroom residences with open-plan layouts, expansive balconies, and large windows that frame stunning views of the sea, lagoon, or landscaped parks. Each unit is designed with attention to detail, featuring fully fitted wardrobes and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for everyday convenience. Tower C is delivered fully furnished with modern, stylish interiors for a seamless move-in experience, while Towers A and B are semi-furnished, allowing residents the freedom to personalize their space. description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Towers A and B are semi-furnished, featuring the same premium built-in wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while enjoying core conveniences. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. description: Discover an exceptional waterfront lifestyle where architectural brilliance meets contemporary luxury. Every residence showcases meticulous craftsmanship and carefully selected materials. Expansive floor-to-ceiling double-glazed glass façades invite natural light into the interiors, while generous three-metre ceiling heights enhance the sense of space and openness. Extra-large porcelain tiles, pre-engineered timber flooring, contemporary carpeting, elegant veneer-finished doors, and thoughtfully designed wardrobes create a harmonious balance of texture and sophistication. One of the area's defining features is its impressive marina and advanced cruise terminal, which contribute to its position as a prominent destination for yachting and cruise tourism. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Business Bay, Dubai
description: Luxury Residences in the Heart of Business Bay, Dubai Experience a new standard of contemporary urban living in Business Bay, one of Dubai's most prestigious and vibrant residential and business destinations. This landmark high-rise development introduces a distinctive concept of vertical living, bringing together six dedicated lifestyle ecosystems designed to create a complete residential experience. Offering an exclusive collection of 432 residences and 90 signature residences, the development features elegant 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, sophisticated duplexes, luxurious penthouses, and an ultra-exclusive royal palace. Designed to combine architectural elegance with everyday functionality, the residences feature thoughtfully planned layouts, generous living spaces, abundant natural light, and seamless transitions between interiors. Premium materials, refined finishes, warm neutral tones, Gulf-inspired colour accents, and elegant metallic details create a sophisticated contemporary atmosphere. Each residence comes with a fully equipped kitchen featuring built-in appliances, while homes are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their interiors. A defining feature of this exceptional development is its impressive collection of more than 75,000 sq. ft. of lifestyle amenities, thoughtfully distributed across multiple levels. Six integrated lifestyle ecosystems cater to wellness, fitness, recreation, entertainment, business, relaxation, and social interaction. From dedicated fitness and leisure spaces to professional facilities and private celebration areas, every element is designed to enrich daily living and provide convenience within the comfort of your own residential community. Prime Location - Business Bay, Dubai Situated in the heart of Business Bay, the development enjoys a strategic address just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa. With convenient connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, residents benefit from easy access to Dubai's major commercial, residential, and lifestyle destinations. Business Bay has evolved into one of the city's most sought-after urban communities, combining a thriving business environment with an exceptional residential lifestyle. The neighbourhood offers an extensive selection of fine-dining restaurants, boutique cafés, luxury hotels, retail destinations, fitness centres, and entertainment venues. The nearby Dubai Water Canal adds another dimension to the lifestyle, with scenic waterfront promenades, leisure activities, and picturesque surroundings. description: Ocean Crest is an elegant coastal residential development that brings together contemporary sophistication and the tranquillity of waterfront living. Thoughtfully designed to reflect the natural beauty of its surroundings, the residences feature a harmonious blend of soft textures, natural light, and timeless colour palettes. Every element is carefully considered to create an inviting atmosphere where modern aesthetics meet comfort, offering residents a peaceful retreat inspired by the rhythm of the sea. The development embraces a refined approach to residential living, with welcoming interiors and thoughtfully planned spaces that balance elegance with functionality. Living areas transition seamlessly into private spaces, creating a natural flow throughout each residence. Contemporary detailing, carefully selected materials, and a calming design philosophy contribute to an environment that feels both sophisticated and effortlessly comfortable, providing an ideal setting for relaxation and everyday living. Beyond the residences, Ocean Crest offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance wellness, leisure, and relaxation. With its coastal-inspired atmosphere and emphasis on comfort, the development offers more than a home-it presents a lifestyle shaped by tranquillity, contemporary design, and the appeal of seaside living. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an emerging waterfront destination designed to bring together coastal living, contemporary residences, hospitality, and leisure within an expansive island setting. Comprising five interconnected islands, the master development features an extensive coastline, scenic beaches, landscaped open spaces, and thoughtfully planned residential and recreational districts. Its distinctive setting offers a refreshing alternative to the city's fast-paced urban environment while maintaining access to Dubai's established lifestyle and business destinations. The destination is envisioned as a comprehensive lifestyle community, with plans for luxury resorts, marinas, beachfront leisure, dining destinations, and retail experiences. Residents can enjoy opportunities for outdoor recreation, including beach activities, water sports, and yachting, alongside landscaped parks and spaces for relaxation. This combination of natural surroundings and lifestyle attractions contributes to the area's appeal for those seeking a contemporary waterfront address. Dubai Islands also benefits from road connections linking the island development to mainland Dubai, supporting access to key destinations across the city. Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and the traditional commercial districts around Deira are accessible by road, while public transport connectivity continues to develop alongside the wider area. Combining coastal scenery, evolving infrastructure, and an expanding collection of lifestyle attractions, Dubai Islands presents an appealing destination for those seeking modern seaside living in Dubai.

raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields. Student rentals near Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) earn 8-9% gross yields. That's 2-3 points more than most of Dubai's residential market. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. description: "Oria is a contemporary residential development by Emaar Properties located in Dubai Creek Harbour, adjacent to the Creek Beach district. The project comprises 163 residential units, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with total areas ranging from approximately 749 to 1,727 sq ft. The development features a waterfront-oriented setting with a creekside promenade and views of the district park and Creek Beach. Residents can enjoy access to recreational facilities, including children's play areas, an adventure playground, a cycling track, a skate park and sports courts, along with connections to public transportation, including an RTA ferry terminal and metro station. Starting prices are AED 1.7 million for one-bedroom apartments, AED 2.7 million for two-bedroom apartments and AED 3.7 million for three-bedroom apartments. The apartments feature balconies, while selected two-bedroom layouts include walk-in closets and the documented three-bedroom layouts offer walk-in closets, laundry rooms and study areas. Oria's location provides convenient access to key destinations across Dubai, with Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary approximately five minutes away, Downtown Dubai around 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport approximately 15 minutes away and Al Maktoum International Airport around 35 minutes away. The development's staged payment plan extends from February 2024 through July 2028, incorporating construction-related milestones. Oria combines contemporary apartment living, recreational amenities and waterfront surroundings within the wider Dubai Creek Harbour community."

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

description: One of the Final Opportunities at DG1 Living Positioned on the 13th floor of the striking DG1 Living, this 126 m² corner apartment presents one of the final opportunities to own a two-bedroom residence within one of Business Bay's most recognisable new developments. Designed by internationally acclaimed architectural firm Gensler and developed by DarGlobal, DG1 combines sculptural architecture with a prime waterfront address beside the Dubai Canal, creating a landmark residential tower in the heart of Dubai. Although the tower enjoys a prestigious canal-side location, this particular residence benefits from an open city outlook, offering expansive urban views across Business Bay together with abundant natural light throughout the day. As one of only two remaining two-bedroom apartments currently available within the project, it represents an increasingly rare opportunity for buyers seeking a premium freehold property before completion. The Residence Every element of this apartment has been designed to maximise comfort, light and functionality. The generous 126 m² layout centres around a spacious open-plan living and dining area that connects seamlessly to the private balcony, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor living. Large floor-to-ceiling windows frame the surrounding cityscape while filling the interiors with natural daylight from multiple directions thanks to the apartment's desirable corner position. The contemporary kitchen integrates naturally with the living spaces, allowing the apartment to function equally well as a permanent residence, a second home or an investment property. Its bold architectural identity distinguishes DG1 from many neighbouring residential developments while providing residents with elegant communal areas and thoughtfully planned living spaces. description: Safa Two by Damac Properties is an exclusive residential development that represents the second chapter of the developer's prestigious Nature of Luxury collection. Strategically located alongside Safa Park in Dubai, this iconic twin-tower development offers an exceptional selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Defined by its distinctive diamond-inspired architecture, the project features an extraordinary suspended hanging garden connecting the two towers, creating a remarkable architectural landmark on Dubai's skyline. Its grand entrance and elegant interiors, enhanced by jewel-inspired design elements, reflect a unique expression of contemporary luxury. Designed to deliver an elevated residential experience, Safa Two combines exceptional architecture with an impressive range of lifestyle amenities. Its signature hanging garden serves as the development's central attraction, offering residents a distinctive leisure environment above the city. Complemented by sophisticated communal spaces, beautifully designed lobbies, and access to the greenery of Safa Park, the development creates a perfect balance between luxury, relaxation, and urban convenience. Inspired by the iconic rubies of de Grisogono, the interiors feature rich scarlet accents that represent passion, energy, and sophistication. Each residence incorporates innovative transformative living spaces with movable walls, allowing homeowners to customize their layouts according to their lifestyle requirements. Premium finishes, carefully selected materials, and fully equipped kitchens with modern appliances further enhance the comfort and functionality of every apartment. Location Description & Benefits Located alongside Safa Park, one of Dubai's most established green destinations, Safa Two enjoys a prestigious address that combines central-city connectivity with peaceful natural surroundings. The development is ideally positioned between some of Dubai's most sought-after districts, including Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, and Jumeirah, offering residents convenient access to the city's key commercial, residential, and lifestyle destinations. The location provides excellent connectivity to major road networks, allowing seamless travel across Dubai. Residents can enjoy beautiful surroundings, including the Dubai Water Canal, landscaped parks, waterfront promenades, and scenic cycling tracks. The development also offers convenient access to iconic landmarks such as Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab, bringing some of the city's most recognizable attractions within easy reach. Safa Two is surrounded by an extensive selection of premium lifestyle destinations, including fine-dining restaurants, luxury shopping destinations, beach clubs, international schools, healthcare facilities, and wellness centers. Its strategic location offers the convenience of city living while maintaining a connection to nature and open spaces. With its distinctive architecture, innovative residential concepts, proximity to Safa Park, and connectivity to Dubai's prime destinations, Safa Two presents an attractive opportunity for both end-users and investors seeking a prestigious address in one of the city's most desirable locations.

Its curved edge follows Aqua Arc's wave-inspired architecture and gives the home a genuine outdoor room rather than a token balcony. The residence carries a community outlook. It is therefore best suited to a buyer who values interior scale, usable outdoor space and a calmer inward-facing position over a direct-sea premium. That distinction should be clear from the outset: the value here comes from proportion and liveability, not from an overstated view claim. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. Al Marjan Island places the residence within Ras Al Khaimah's established waterfront and hospitality corridor. For an international second-home buyer, the oversized balcony and complete supporting rooms make the apartment practical beyond a short visit. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Bright open spaces, bespoke storage solutions, and refined finishes create a timeless living environment that combines style with practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. description: Branded Luxury Apartments with Installments in Downtown Dubai Downtown Dubai is the city's vibrant flagship district, renowned for its iconic landmarks, world-class lifestyle, and unmatched investment appeal. Home to the majestic Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, and the captivating Dubai Fountain, it offers a perfect blend of luxury living, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Additional luxuries include a private salon, events space, Bellini Bar, cinema, library, billiards and media rooms, podcast and art studios, a kids' club, and a refrigerated delivery area. Designed by the renowned studio 1508 London, the interiors are a contemporary interpretation of classic design, enriched with premium finishes, bespoke Italian kitchens, fitted wardrobes, and top-tier kitchen white goods. Apartments are delivered without soft furniture but come complete with refined elements such as curtains, wallpapers, and curated design details that elevate each space. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows fill the interiors with natural light, while high ceilings and open layouts create a sense of grandeur. The master bedrooms serve as serene retreats, featuring custom Italian vanities, luxurious bathtubs, and elegant shower enclosures. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

The living spaces have options for both light and dark interior schemes. Wide windows allow for an abundance of natural light and connects residents to the tranquil views of Saadiyat Island. description: Volta by DAMAC Properties is a premium residential development situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering an exceptional blend of contemporary architecture, urban sophistication, and upscale living. The development features a diverse collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments alongside super-luxury three- and four-bedroom residences, catering to a range of lifestyle preferences. Designed to complement Dubai's dynamic cityscape, the tower combines elegant residential spaces with modern functionality, further enhanced by a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure for added convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully curated lifestyle with dedicated recreational spaces and leisure amenities, including a rooftop amenity area atop the separate podium parking structure. Its prime Downtown Dubai location places residents within easy reach of prestigious shopping destinations, fine dining establishments, entertainment venues, and renowned cultural landmarks. This combination of urban connectivity, premium facilities, and contemporary residential design creates an appealing living environment for those seeking a sophisticated city lifestyle. The interiors are finished with carefully selected materials and contemporary detailing to create a refined and functional living experience. Living and dining areas feature elegant marble flooring, painted walls, and selected accent finishes, while bedrooms incorporate porcelain tile flooring, built-in wardrobes, and thoughtfully designed feature walls in the master bedroom. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the spectacular Dubai Fountain, the district offers an exceptional combination of luxury shopping, fine dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Its dynamic environment attracts residents and visitors throughout the year, making it one of Dubai's most recognisable lifestyle and residential destinations. The neighbourhood offers a sophisticated urban lifestyle, with an extensive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, stylish cafés, and high-end leisure destinations. Beyond its commercial appeal, Downtown Dubai provides a vibrant residential environment where everyday conveniences and entertainment are seamlessly integrated. From designer boutiques and international restaurants to scenic promenades and lively public spaces, the district caters to those who appreciate a connected and contemporary way of living. Strategically positioned near Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Al Wasl, and Business Bay, Downtown Dubai benefits from excellent connectivity to key commercial districts, residential communities, and major destinations across the city. Its accessible transport links and proximity to essential amenities make it particularly attractive to professionals, frequent travellers, and residents seeking convenient urban living. Combining a prestigious address, landmark surroundings, and a thriving lifestyle scene, Downtown Dubai continues to stand out as one of the city's most desirable destinations for luxury residential living.

title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1215. Discover a new residential icon in the heart of Dubai, a 450-metre-tall, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Situated on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this development elevates the urban experience by combining architectural elegance, endless views, and a direct connection to the city's most relevant areas. Just minutes from Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown and Jumeirah Beach, it offers a prime location that ensures mobility, convenience and the possibility of living in the centre of it all. The building comprises 684 residences, spread between one- to four-bedroom apartments and exclusive duplexes, each designed as a tranquil refuge elevated above the urban hustle and bustle. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto the sea and skyline, providing abundant natural light and a continuous sense of spaciousness. Private balconies extend this connection to the landscape, while interior finishes including porcelain floors, fully equipped kitchens with appliances from recognised brands and bathrooms with premium materials guarantee comfort, quality and sophistication in every detail. The integrated technology allows you to control light and air conditioning, transforming each residence into a modern and functional space. The tower also stands out for its four sky-parks, distributed vertically and created to offer distinct worlds suspended in the air. The first is dedicated to family energy, with leisure spaces, activities for children, play areas and sports areas that promote moments of conviviality. The second focuses on well-being, with three levels that bring together a running track, training areas, yoga areas and garden terraces, creating perfect environments for both physical activity and moments of leisure. The third is a quiet refuge full of vegetation, sensory paths, glass pavilions and quiet corners that invite reading, reflection and rest. The room, situated at about 370 meters high, offers a suspended resort atmosphere, with an infinity pool, floating deck and spaces intended to relax while the horizon lights up with the sunset. The experience begins right in the lobby, a space designed to convey serenity and grandeur through the careful use of stone, wood and metal elements that filter light in a gentle way, creating a feeling of warmth even before entering the house. The entire building was developed to convey harmony, verticality and lightness, transforming each route from the arrival at the lobby to the highest levels into a natural extension of contemporary urban life. Scheduled for completion in December 2031, this development represents a unique investment opportunity in one of Dubai's most impressive and elevated residential projects. Here, every detail has been thought out to offer a distinctive, modern and balanced life, where the sky becomes part of everyday life and the city stretches out from your feet. #ref:8952

description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View, it is home to luxury resorts, beach clubs, water sports, and world-class hospitality brands like Rixos, Mövenpick, and DoubleTree. The project rises 16 storeys above the Arabian Gulf on Al Marjan Island, designed as a sculptural icon that cascades organically towards the sea, blending architecture with nature to create an exclusive waterfront sanctuary. Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Residents are welcomed through a grand arrival drop-off and a striking residential lobby, with direct access to retail outlets at the ground level. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. The architectural layout integrates seamlessly with its environment. This destination is just minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort and key Ras Al Khaimah attractions, positioning it as a prime address for upscale living and future investment. The project presents a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend contemporary luxury with serene coastal living. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. The design palette embodies understated elegance, featuring soft neutral tones, premium finishes, and the incorporation of natural materials like stone to create a calm, organic ambiance. Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. Spacious balconies extend the living areas outdoors, enhancing the connection to nature and creating private sanctuaries for relaxation. The interiors are a harmonious balance of functionality and style, crafted to deliver comfort, sophistication, and a lifestyle rooted in both beauty and practicality. RKT-00021

title: V46V+3V, Dubai
description: Grove Ridge is a tranquil residential community nestled within the lush surroundings of Emaar South, where contemporary architecture blends seamlessly with the beauty of golf-course living. Surrounded by expansive green landscapes, rolling fairways, and open skies, the development offers a peaceful setting designed to promote relaxation, balance, and a strong sense of community. Its architectural style combines clean modern lines with understated elegance, creating a harmonious relationship between thoughtfully designed residences and the natural environment. The development offers an impressive selection of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and social connection. Residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, dedicated yoga spaces, a padel court, children's play areas and pools, and outdoor barbecue zones. Direct access to the championship golf course further enhances the appeal, offering an exceptional setting for golf enthusiasts and outdoor living. Within the wider master-planned community, residents also benefit from convenient access to retail outlets, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and recreational destinations. Featuring a curated collection of one- to three-bedroom apartments and townhouses, Grove Ridge is designed to combine modern functionality with a calming residential atmosphere. Open-plan layouts maximise space and natural light, while expansive green views create a seamless connection with the outdoors. The interiors draw inspiration from nature, incorporating soft neutral palettes, refined textures, and contemporary finishes to establish a warm and inviting ambience. Every residence is thoughtfully planned to balance comfort, sophistication, and practicality, offering a peaceful retreat within a vibrant golf-course community. Location Description and Benefits Emaar South is a thoughtfully planned residential destination offering a diverse range of homes, including apartments, townhouses, and villas, designed to accommodate different lifestyles and family needs. Characterised by contemporary architecture, landscaped surroundings, and community-focused planning, the area offers a balanced residential environment that combines modern convenience with open green spaces. Its strategic position near Al Maktoum International Airport and the Expo City Dubai district adds to its appeal for professionals, frequent travellers, and those seeking opportunities in Dubai's growing southern corridor. The community places a strong emphasis on outdoor living and recreational experiences, with landscaped parks, green spaces, walking paths, and dedicated areas for leisure and family activities. Residents can enjoy a range of lifestyle facilities, including swimming pools, fitness centres, sports amenities, and community gathering spaces, encouraging an active and connected way of life. These features create an appealing environment for families and individuals seeking a more relaxed pace of living away from the city's busiest districts. Emaar South also benefits from access to everyday conveniences, with retail destinations, dining options, educational facilities, and healthcare services available within the wider community and surrounding areas. Its connectivity to major road networks and proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport support convenient travel across Dubai and beyond. With its emphasis on green living, recreational amenities, and long-term urban development, Emaar South presents an attractive residential destination for those seeking a combination of contemporary comfort, community living, and future growth potential.

title: DIFC Heights Tower
description:
DIFC Heights Tower is the second residential development from Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), following DIFC Living. The mixed-use tower stands on Al Mostaqbal Street in DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre), between Index Tower and DAMAC Park Towers, and rises to ground plus 47 floors, with 32 residential floors and seven commercial floors. Its 366 homes range from one-bedroom apartments of 871 sq ft to four-bedroom duplexes of 3,618 sq ft, with two- and three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom duplexes in between.

Interiors use pastel tones, high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glazing, and the homes are semi-furnished, with Bosch kitchen appliances in the apartments and Miele in the duplexes. Shared facilities include a gym, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, a family lounge, an indoor kids' play area, a multipurpose hall and a co-working space, alongside landscaped terraces at the podium and amenity levels. The tower opens onto Gate Avenue at both ground and podium level, a Dubai Metro station is about five minutes on foot, Burj Khalifa and the Museum of the Future are around five minutes by car, and Dubai International Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

DIFC is home to more than 46,000 professionals working across over 6,900 registered companies, so the homes sit close to a large and established workforce. The developer is the financial centre itself, and the building combines residences with offices and retail in a single address. The payment plan is 5% on booking, 65% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.
